mapper.select: SELECT id,user_id,name,phone,note,account_id FROM recipients WHERE id=#{id} AND user_id=#{userId}

SELECT r.id,r.name,r.note,a.label FROM recipients r JOIN accounts a ON r.account_id=a.id WHERE r.user_id=#{userId} AND (r.name=#{query} OR r.phone=#{query} OR r.note=#{query} OR r.id=#{query} OR a.label=#{query}) ORDER BY r.id
